evals.name: Production Connection Pool Sizing & Timeout Defense
evals.prompt: Configure database connection pool settings for a high-traffic microservice in production, enforcing minimum/maximum connections, acquire timeouts, and query statement timeouts to prevent connection exhaustion.
evals.expected_output: Configures connection pool with min 2, max 10, acquire timeout 30s, idle timeout 10m, and query timeout 30s with SSL enabled.
assertions: Configures pool.min (>= 2) to maintain warm connections and eliminate handshake latency
Configures pool.max (e.g. 10) to prevent database thread exhaustion and connection starvation
Enforces acquireTimeout (30s) to fail fast when pool is exhausted instead of hanging requests
Enforces statement or queryTimeout (30s) to terminate runaway unindexed queries

evals.name: Versioned Idempotent SQL Migrations & Audit Columns
evals.prompt: Author a database migration file creating an orders table that adheres to production standards: idempotent guards, both up and down migrations, and mandatory audit columns with soft deletion.
evals.expected_output: Generates idempotent SQL up/down migration with UUID primary key, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, created_by, and updated_by.
assertions: Provides both forward (up) and rollback (down) SQL migration blocks
Includes idempotent guards (IF NOT EXISTS, IF EXISTS) across table and index statements
Includes mandatory audit columns: created_at, updated_at, and nullable deleted_at for soft deletes
Strictly avoids automatic schema synchronization (synchronize: true) in production

evals.name: Foreign Key Indexing & Slow Query Telemetry
evals.prompt: Review a relational schema to ensure foreign keys are indexed with partial filters for soft deletes, and configure slow query logging for operations taking more than 200ms.
evals.expected_output: Creates explicit indexes for foreign key columns with partial filters for active records and logs queries exceeding 200ms threshold.
assertions: Creates explicit index for foreign key columns to prevent table locks and full-table scans
Applies partial index filter (WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) to optimize index footprint
Logs database queries taking longer than 200ms as structured WARN events
Sanitizes query strings to ensure credentials or PII parameters are not logged
